profile_text.body:
Digital Realty Trust, Inc. is a public company headquartered in Austin, Texas, traded under the ticker DLR, with SEC CIK 0001297996. Its website describes it as a data center and colocation provider, offering interconnection capabilities across a global ecosystem of data centers, connectivity and cloud services. The company describes its platform as the world's largest data center platform, serving deployments that range from single racks to private suites and high-density AI workflows, and says it is built for flexibility, open ecosystems and reach.

On AI, the site frames the company's role as infrastructure rather than AI products. It states that inference loads and GPU demands are pushing traditional environments to their limits, and that AI is evolving faster than infrastructure can lag behind. It also promotes a 2026 Global Data Insights Survey, citing that 40% of IT leaders name infrastructure as an AI constraint and describing a shift among enterprises from AI strategy to execution.

The litigation record shows no individual cases, with a Texas law exposure count of 125. No AI products or MCP servers are listed for the company.
